function: Function: a GAN synthesizes CSI fingerprints, and multi-agent PSRO plans their collection paths, for indoor localization; p. 2: "fingerprint database is constructed to realize indoor positioning".
notes: The PDF is the paper of the DOI (p. 1: title 'CPPU: Policy Space Diversity for Informative Path Planning and GAI-Enabled Updating CSI in ISAC' and DOI 10.1109/TCCN.2024.3522088). Reason function (positioning or localization). The learned parts are a multi-agent diverse-PSRO planner of the paths along which CSI is collected (p. 6-7, Algorithm 2) and a conditional GAN that predicts CSI fingerprints at unsampled grid points (p. 7, Fig. 6); the resulting fine-grained database feeds KNN location estimation (p. 8: 'we use the K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm to estimate locations during the online phase'; Fig. 5 ends in 'Location estimation'). All results are positioning error, sampling counts, MI reward, and training time (p. 9: 'The cumulative distribution function (CDF) of positioning error is used as the measurement standard'; Tables I-III, Figs. 8-16). Earlier codes checked: source_type and survey do not apply; no_learning does not apply (PSRO and GAN are learned); above_phy covers the path planning of the collection agents, but the GAN acts on physical-layer CSI, so the work is not purely above the PHY. Borderline with area 2 (synthesis of the channel): the GAN generates CSI, but only as localization fingerprints, with no channel estimation or prediction error and no communication metric reported. If the reviewer judges the fingerprint GAN not to be a physical-layer function, the first applicable code would be above_phy instead. The link is 802.11n WiFi between Intel 5300 NICs with three antennas, 30 subcarriers, measured in a lab (NLoS) and a meeting room (LoS) (p. 8).
